mode.hint: Choose a mode with Start agent.
mode.simulation_text: Replays the hand-authored run offline: no key, no model calls, no cost. The engines recompute every figure, and your decisions are your own.
mode.live_text: The agent calls Claude with your API key, at most {calls} model calls and {eur} per run.
mode.live_key_needed: Needs an API key; it is checked for free before the start.
mode.sovereign_text: The same agent against an OpenAI-compatible endpoint that you operate.

step.inventory: Inventory: the agent reads the slice's norms and records reporting, proof, information, documentation, evaluation and control duties with their citation.
step.duplicates: Duplicates: duties that ask the same businesses for the same data are clustered; a register could supply the data.
step.prices: Prices: every duty and every option is priced with the compliance cost (Erfüllungsaufwand) method. Every figure has a source or carries the label Assumption.
step.decision: Decision: you approve, reject or ask for information. Only your approval enters the dossier, and nothing is sent.

notice.nudge: The agent paused before finishing the plan; Duty Radar asked it to continue.
notice.incomplete: The agent stopped twice before the closing report; the run ends incomplete.
notice.retry: The API reported a transient problem; retrying in {seconds} s (attempt {attempt} of 2).
notice.cap_calls: The limit of model calls is reached; the run ends with the closing report.
notice.cap_cost: The cost limit is reached; the run ends with the closing report.
notice.error: The run stopped because of an unexpected error: {message}
notice.key_rejected: Key rejected: Anthropic rejected the API key (401). It has been removed from this tab.

notice.model_unavailable: This model is not available to the API key. Please choose another.
